title: Di Bawah Helm
mood: tired and quietly grateful, swelling into a full room singing back
subject: an ojek driver who works Sundays and listens to the sermon on one earbud in the church car park between rides, singing the closing worship song under his helmet while he waits for the next order
caption: Indonesian praise and worship in the live megachurch ballad style. Wide analog-style synth pads swelling under every section; an ambient electric guitar with dotted-eighth delay and shimmer reverb playing volume-swelled single notes; a Rhodes electric piano holding the chords; electric bass on steady root eighths; drums that start on soft floor-tom pulses, move to a soft straight backbeat with closed hi-hats in the verses and open into a four-on-the-floor kick with crash washes for the bridge build. A wide, roomy live-church sound, the pads and the lead vocal forward, a congregation singing the chorus and bridge back from behind. Male worship leader, warm clean baritone that opens into a strong belt on the chorus, plain conversational Indonesian phrasing. 72 BPM, A major. Tired and quietly grateful, swelling into a full room singing back. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no gospel choir runs.
lyrics:
[Intro - synth pad swell and one delayed guitar note]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pagi aku antar ibu ke gereja
Dia masuk, aku parkir di bawah ketapang
Jaket hijau, helm belum kulepas
Kiri buat khotbah, kanan buat orderan

[Pre-Chorus]
Pendeta bilang, "Yang letih, datanglah"
Aku kira itu buat yang di dalam aja

[Chorus]
Tuhan, aku di parkiran
Helm di kepala, mesin belum dingin
Mereka nyanyi di dalam gedung
Aku ikut pelan di bawah helm ini

[Verse 2]
Lagu penutup mulai dari dalam
Tukang parkir ikut nyanyi, peluitnya di saku
Earphone kananku bunyi, orderan masuk
Aku biarin lewat, satu lagu lagi aja

[Chorus]
Tuhan, aku di parkiran
Helm di kepala, mesin belum dingin
Orderan lewat, nggak apa-apa
Lagu ini buat yang di luar juga

[Bridge - floor toms turn into four-on-the-floor, the congregation sings each line back]
Dari gedung sampai parkiran
(Dari gedung sampai parkiran)
Engkau dengar semuanya
(Engkau dengar semuanya)

[Chorus - full band, the whole room sings]
Tuhan, aku di parkiran
Helm di kepala, mesin belum dingin
Ibu tadi keluar, naik motorku lagi
Kami nyanyi berdua sampai rumah

[Outro - pad alone, one delayed guitar note fading]
